name: How important is it to have a real estate agent when buying new construction?

mainEntity.name: How important is it to have a real estate agent when buying new construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Having an independent real estate agent is highly important when buying new construction, even when dealing directly with a developer's sales team. A developer's agent represents the builder's interests, not yours. Your own agent, such as one from Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution, will advocate for you, help negotiate terms, explain contracts that can be complex, and ensure you understand all aspects of the purchase, including potential hidden costs or future assessments. They can provide unbiased guidance and protect your investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: An independent real estate agent is crucial when buying new construction because they represent your interests, help negotiate terms, and navigate complex contracts, unlike a developer's sales team.
